instruction: Open the browser and navigate to the browsing history page where you can view all previously visited websites.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Chrome's history page (chrome://history/). Uses existing evaluator functions - is_expected_active_tab_approximate metric and active_url_from_accessTree getter. No new functions needed. Similar difficulty to original task (simple navigation).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic is semantically correct for verifying the instruction
Getter (active_url_from_accessTree) correctly extracts the active tab URL from Chrome's address bar via accessibility tree
Metric (is_expected_active_tab_approximate) correctly compares the actual URL against expected URL, ignoring query parameters which is appropriate for chrome:// URLs
Expected value is correct: chrome://history/ is the exact URL for Chrome's browsing history page
Complete coverage: instruction only requires navigating to history page, evaluator verifies exactly that
Data flow is correct: getter returns string URL -> metric handles both string and dict formats -> compares against expected URL
Runtime feasibility: getter can access accessibility tree to read address bar text, metric can perform URL string comparison
